test_title: PYST 44: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the highlighted group of words in the given sentence.

We went to Bowbazar in Kolkata to see **the buildings for the lodging and accommodation of soldiers.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Barracks**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Barracks"** refers to buildings or a set of buildings used for lodging and housing soldiers. (सैनिकों के ठहरने का स्थान)

 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers returned to their barracks after completing the training drill.
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the highlighted phrase "buildings for the lodging and accommodation of soldiers" can be replaced with the one-word substitute "Barracks." (सैनिकों के ठहरने के स्थान का उल्लेख करने के लिए)
 
 
• **Example:** The barracks in Bowbazar were built during colonial times.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Barracks**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Padlocks** (ताले): A detachable lock hanging by a pivoted hook.

 
 
• **Example:** The warehouse was secured with strong padlocks to prevent theft.
 
 
 
• **Hostels** (छात्रावास): A place providing cheap lodging, especially for students or travelers.
 
 
• **Example:** The students stayed in the university hostel during their course.
 
 
 
• **Inns** (सराय): A small hotel or a place providing lodging and food for travelers.
 
 
• **Example:** We stopped at an old inn on our way to the mountains.
 
 

33:Td86,

The correct answer is: **Ambigram**.
